4.text:
P(t) = 1,900(1.07)^t

The function P gives the estimated number of sea lions in a certain area, where t is the number of years since a study began. What is the best interpretation of P(0) = 1,900 in this context?

choices.A: The estimated number of sea lions in the area increased by 1,900 each year during the study.
choices.B: The estimated number of sea lions in the area increased by 107 each year during the study.
choices.C: The estimated number of sea lions in the area was 1,900 when the study began.
choices.D: The estimated number of sea lions in the area was 107 when the study began.

4.showWork: t = 0 is when the study began, so P(0) = 1,900 is the estimated sea lion count at the start.

6.text: Circle N has a radius of 7 millimeters (mm). Circle M has an area of 169π mm². What is the total area, in mm², of circles N and M?

7.text: Points F and G lie on a circle with center H. Segment FG is a diameter of the circle. If the length of segment FG is 98 centimeters, what is the length, in centimeters, of segment FH?
7.showWork: FH is a radius (center H to point F). Radius = diameter/2 = 98/2 = 49.

14.text:
A farmer gave two groups of chickens different types of chicken feed for a month to measure the effect on egg production. The lists give the number of eggs collected from each chicken in each of the two groups.
Group G: 9, 15, 18, 18, 24
Group H: 15, 18, 18, 24
Which statement correctly compares the median number of eggs collected for group G and the median number of eggs collected for group H?

choices.A: The median number of eggs collected for group G is equal to the median number of eggs collected for group H.
choices.B: The median number of eggs collected for group G is greater than the median number of eggs collected for group H.
choices.C: The median number of eggs collected for group G is less than the median number of eggs collected for group H.
choices.D: There is not enough information to compare the median number of eggs collected for group G and the median number of eggs collected for group H.

14.showWork: Median G (5 values): 18. Median H (4 values): (18+18)/2 = 18. Medians are equal.

15.stimulus: The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, x and y. A line of best fit is also shown.
15.text: Which of the following equations best represents the line of best fit shown?
15.figure: First-quadrant scatterplot. x-axis 0–6 (unit ticks, label x), y-axis 0–6 (unit ticks, label y), origin O. ~12 black points in an upward linear pattern. Solid line of best fit through approx (0,0), (3,2.1), (6,4.2); slope 0.7.
15.showWork: Line of best fit passes through (0,0) and (3,2.1), so slope = 2.1/3 = 0.7 → y = 0.7x.

20.text: If 10 + 8(7 - x)/5 = 5(7 - x)/3, what is the value of 7 - x?
20.showWork: Let u = 7 - x. Then 10 + 8u/5 = 5u/3. Multiply by 15: 150 + 24u = 25u → u = 150.

21.text: In the figure, triangle ABF is congruent to triangle EDG, where B corresponds to D. The measure of angle DCF is 52°. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle ABF?
21.figure: Two overlapping right triangles on a horizontal base A–G–F–E (left to right). △ABF: right angle at A, B above A, hypotenuse BF. △EDG: right angle at E, D above E, hypotenuse DG. BF and DG intersect at C. Note: Figure not drawn to scale.
21.showWork: Congruent → ∠AFB = ∠EGD. In △GCF those base angles are equal; ∠GCF = 180° - 52° = 128° (linear pair with ∠DCF). So each base angle = (180-128)/2 = 26°. Then ∠ABF = 90° - 26° = 64°.
